name: Player Studio house item submissions
statement: Geometry files must be submitted in OBJ format and texture maps in TGA format.

article.title: Free Realms - Player Studio Get Started

name: Player Studio house item submissions
statement: Every OBJ file must have its own texture map, and texture maps must be 32-bit TGA with no alpha channel.
quote: All texture maps must be in 32-bit TGA with no Alpha channel.

article.title: Free Realms - Player Studio Get Started

name: Player Studio house item submissions
statement: OBJ supports only one UV set, so extra detail such as grime must be painted into the texture instead.
quote: OBJ supports only 1 UV set.

article.title: Free Realms - Player Studio Get Started

name: Player Studio house item submissions
statement: Mirrored UVs are acceptable and encouraged for house items because of the one-material limit.
quote: Mirrored UVs are acceptable and even encouraged for house items given the 1 material limit.

article.title: Free Realms - Player Studio Get Started

name: Player Studio house item submissions
statement: UVs must be checked to lie within 0-1 UV space before submission.
quote: Please double-check that UVs are within 0-1 UV space before submission.

article.title: Free Realms - Player Studio Get Started

name: Player Studio house item submissions
statement: Texture guidance: do not paint heavy shadowing, the normal map should show the primary relief, and spec maps should look semi-gloss or matte with near-white used sparingly.
quote: Do not paint-in heavy shadowing. The normal map should expose the primary relief across surfaces.

article.title: Free Realms - Player Studio Get Started

name: Player Studio house item submissions
statement: House items may have at most 1000 polygons; LoD meshes are not needed and quad topology is not required.
quote: 1000 polygons is the maximum. No Level of Detail (LoD) meshes are necessary.

article.title: Free Realms - Player Studio Get Started

name: Player Studio house item submissions
statement: A finished item must be one combined mesh, with only one mesh in the scene and no loose shells or extra pieces.
quote: The finished item must be submitted as 1 combined mesh.

article.title: Free Realms - Player Studio Get Started

name: Player Studio house item submissions
statement: Polygons that serve no shape, silhouette, or UV purpose should be removed, and edges should be softened or hardened appropriately.
quote: If a polygon doesn't serve a shape/silhouette/UV purpose, it should not be there.

article.title: Free Realms - Player Studio Get Started

name: Player Studio house item submissions
statement: Modelers are advised to size objects against a human scale, where a human is about 6 feet in Free Realms.
quote: a human is about 6 feet in Free Realms

article.title: Free Realms - Player Studio Get Started

name: Player Studio submissions
statement: Player Studio items must follow the game's playful, colourful, organic art style, avoiding sharp corners and straight lines.
